name: Anek Bangla
description: A contemporary grotesque from the multi-script Anek family, compact and confident in headlines. Eight weights and a variable font.

name: Noto Sans Bengali
description: An unmodulated sans for Bangla from the Noto project, built to harmonise across scripts. Nine weights and a variable font.

name: Noto Serif Bengali
description: The modulated serif companion to Noto Sans Bengali, suited to long-form reading. Nine weights and a variable font.

name: Hind Siliguri
description: A humanist sans designed for user interfaces, with open counters and even rhythm. Five weights.

name: Tiro Bangla
designer: Tiro Typeworks — John Hudson, Fiona Ross
description: A classical text face for literary publishing, with a true italic.

name: Baloo Da 2
description: A rounded, heavy-spirited display face with real warmth. Five weights and a variable font.

name: Atma
description: A playful, hand-drawn display face that works for comics, children’s books and headlines. Five weights.

name: Mina
description: A geometric sans with a technical feel, in regular and bold.

name: Galada
description: A brush script for Bangla, built as the companion to the Latin script face Lobster.

name: Kalpurush
description: Designed by Md. Tanbin Islam Siyam and developed under the Avro Free Bangla Font Project.

name: SolaimanLipi
description: Designed by Solaiman Karim and later updated by Saif Hassan. One of the most widely used Bangla Unicode fonts.

name: SiyamRupali
description: A modified version of the Rupali Bangla font, hinted by Md. Tanbin Islam Siyam and developed under the Avro Free Bangla Font Project.

name: AdorshoLipi
description: A clean, upright Bangla text face.

name: AponaLohit
description: The Lohit font from Ekushey with additional hinting for a better look on screen. TrueType hinting was started by Ershadul Haq and later improved by Alamgir Mohammed.

name: EkusheyLohit
description: Glyphs taken from Lohit Bengali, designed by Automatic Control Equipments, with Unicode conversion by Ekushey.

name: Mukti
description: Developed by Dr. Anirban Mitra for the Free Bangla Font Project.

name: Bangla
description: A classic Bangla Unicode text face.

name: BenSen
description: A Bangla text face developed by Subrata Sen.

name: CharuChandan3D
description: A three-dimensional display face from the Charu Chandan collection.

name: CharuChandanHardStroke
description: A heavy brush-stroke display face from the Charu Chandan collection.

name: CharukolaUltraLight
description: A hairline display face from the Charu Chandan collection.

name: Inter
description: A workhorse sans built for screens, with a tall x-height and careful spacing. Variable from thin to black, with italics.

name: Roboto
description: The mechanical-yet-friendly sans behind Android and Material Design. Variable across nine weights, with italics.

name: Open Sans
description: A neutral humanist sans with open forms, tuned for legibility in print, web and mobile interfaces.

name: Noto Sans
description: The Latin, Greek and Cyrillic core of the Noto project, designed to look consistent across the world’s scripts.

name: Montserrat
description: A geometric sans inspired by the old posters and signs of the Montserrat neighbourhood of Buenos Aires.

name: Poppins
description: A geometric sans built on near-perfect circles, in nine weights with italics.

name: Lato
description: A warm, semi-rounded sans that stays serious in body text and shows its character at large sizes.

name: Nunito
description: A well-balanced sans with rounded terminals, friendly in interfaces and headlines alike.

name: Raleway
designer: Matt McInerney, Pablo Impallari, Rodrigo Fuenzalida
description: An elegant sans with a display heart, best known for its thin weights and distinctive w.

name: DM Sans
description: A low-contrast geometric sans made for text at smaller sizes.

name: Work Sans
description: A grotesque loosely based on early sans serifs, optimised for on-screen text at medium sizes.

name: Manrope
description: A modern sans that crosses grotesque and geometric shapes, with semi-condensed proportions.

name: Rubik
description: A sans with slightly rounded corners, wide and soft-spoken.

name: Outfit
description: A clean geometric sans drawn for brand systems, from thin to black.

name: Plus Jakarta Sans
description: A fresh geometric sans first commissioned for the city of Jakarta.

name: Space Grotesk
description: A proportional sans derived from Space Mono, keeping its quirky details.

name: Oswald
description: A condensed gothic for headlines, reworked from classic newspaper styles to fit the pixel grid.

name: Bebas Neue
description: An all-caps display sans with clean lines and tall, tight proportions.

name: Playfair Display
description: A high-contrast transitional serif for headlines, in the spirit of late eighteenth-century type.

name: Merriweather
description: A serif designed to be pleasant to read on screens, with a large x-height and sturdy serifs.

name: Lora
description: A contemporary serif with calligraphic roots, well suited to body text.

name: Source Sans 3
description: Adobe’s first open-source typeface family, a clear sans made for user interfaces.

name: JetBrains Mono
description: A monospace made for developers, with increased letter height and coding ligatures.

name: Fira Code
description: A monospace with programming ligatures, extended from Fira Mono.

name: Roboto Mono
description: The monospaced member of the Roboto family, optimised for readability in code.

name: Tiempos Headline
description: A headline serif in four weights with italics.
